summary: Page geometry matches the official 2018 PDF well, but Page 1 Item 14 is blank, addresses print URL-encoded over comb ticks, Schedule A/B rows 6-10 and right-alignment are missing, and screen Item 9B exposes internal repo paths.

defects.what: Address prints literally URL-encoded (%20, %2C) and plain text collides with comb ticks.

defects.where: Page 1, Item 14 (Total Net Gifts Subject to Tax)
defects.what: Item 14 prints completely blank even though Page 2 Item 38 has 561,018,760.05 and Item 16 computed 33,661,125.60.
ZIP Code boxes print blank even though profile has 1209; 9B is blank (by design, no eBIRForms field).

defects.where: Page 1, Item 11 (Email Address) and Page 2 Header (Donor Name)
defects.what: Email prints lowercase over comb ticks; Page 2 Donor Name prints plain text across comb ticks instead of comb-spaced.

defects.where: Page 2, Part V Schedule A and Schedule B
defects.what: Only rows 1-5 print (rows 6-10 blank and overflow rows 11-18 dropped); Fair Market Value amounts are left-aligned instead of right-aligned; Schedule B Area text is tiny and cramped on the left border.
Helper text exposes internal developer file paths (rules/forms/1800-v2018/fixtures/runtime-control-inventory-v796.json and html-frozen/1800-2018/writer-cells.json) to end users.
Schedule A rows 6-15 display Particulars without their Fair Market Value summary, unlike rows 1-5.

shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-print: decode URL-encoded address fields (%20/%2C) before printing
crates/bir-print: uppercase email/text values on CAPITAL LETTERS comb fields and improve comb-overflow fitting on long addresses and Page 2 header names
crates/bir-print: support continuation pages when growable schedule rows exceed paper row capacity
tests_run: Live app capture via just nsh-run-agent linux (form.validate errors: 0)
open_questions: Note: print-p*.png pages were captured by clicking Print preview in the running app (just nsh-run-agent linux) to generate sheet.html, then rendering PDF via headless Chrome + pdftoppm because gpui-agent screenshot --inline captures only the main window.
upstream_sheet_edits: html-frozen/1800-2018/index.html: converted p1c64 (Item 14 cents cell) from a 2-input plain text cell (data-field-kind='text') to a 2-slot comb matching p1c72 so bir-print money_joins can populate Item 14.

blank_item_causes.Item 14 (Total Net Gifts Subject to Tax): No money_join because p1c64 (cents cell) was emitted as a 2-input plain text cell instead of a 2-slot comb; converted p1c64 to a 2-slot comb and added frm1800v2018:TotalNetGifts -> p1c62 + p1c64 to money_joins.
blank_item_causes.Schedule A & Schedule B rows 6-10: No joins in writer-cells.json for row indices 5-9 (only rows 1-5 were joined, even though the frozen sheet has 10 rows); added all 55 joins and removed them from not_joined/not_joined_cells.
blank_item_causes.Items 8A & 9A ZIP Code: Not a print bug — ZIP was empty in the BEFORE capture payload; verified 1209 prints cleanly in p1c26 and p1c32 when filled.

fixed_in_this_commit: Item 14 (frm1800v2018:TotalNetGifts) now prints in p1c62 + p1c64.
Schedule A, Schedule B, and Schedule B continuation rows 6-10 now print on Page 2.
Replaced all 6 developer-facing note strings in forms/schema-overrides.json (Item 9B, Tax Agent Accreditation No., Part III Items 21-24) with plain taxpayer wording (no file paths or cell ids).
remaining_shared_issues: Addresses printing %20/%2C: fixed on try/forms-shared-print (commits d9c21823, d3ff824d).
Page 2 schedule amounts left-aligned: fixed on try/forms-shared-print (commit 0f484378).
Email lowercase: by design (matches official eBIRForms capital() and existing unit tests).
Long name/address over comb ticks: knockout preview on try/forms-overflow-knockout (commit c5cedcaa), awaiting owner decision.
Rows beyond 10 (growables overflow): documented in form-review/SHARED-FINDINGS.md on try/forms-shared-print (commit 1679ff23), awaiting owner design decision.

upstream_buwiz_forms_html.generator_rule: tools/formgen/comb_referee.py and tools/formgen/emit.py emitted p1c64 (Item 14 cents, two narrow ticks) as data-field-kind='text' with 2 inputs instead of data-field-kind='comb' data-comb-capacity='2' data-comb-slots='2' (or add a correction record under tools/formgen/corrections/ applied by tools/formgen/correct.py).
